info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Petsupply Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed listings for petsupply pendants within the catalog. Users can submit specific attributes and information associated with each pendant, ensuring comprehensive representation of products. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require up-to-date product information. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their product visibility and drive customer engagement through accurate catalog displays.

post.summary: Create a new pet supply pendant detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit new details for a pet supply pendant, helping to manage your inventory more effectively. Make sure to provide all required information in the request body.

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing details required for adding a pet supply pendant. This includes all necessary attributes relevant to the pet supply pendant, ensuring that the request adheres to the expected schema format.
